question: KRE-074 / N1R-b foundation: client KR chấp nhận endpoint proxy loopback và UDP giữ nguyên qua companion xác thực không?
scope: Nền kr-tunnel certificate-pinned QUIC/capability/replay/bounded proxy và native2 static private route control. Không serving ownership hoặc N1R-b closure; không đổi service runtime.

findings.limits: Known fixed2/Wine/privateLAN/static lab routes only. One final ingress at observer boundary has no helper complete and no apply claim; no Internet or N1R-b closure.
